title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Judges 7: Gideon's three hundred, with the test at the water, the barley-bread dream and the night attack with trumpets, pitchers and torches.

questions.text: Beside which spring did Gideon and his people encamp?
questions.explanation: Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people with him encamped beside the spring of Harod.

questions.text: After the fearful and trembling were told to go home, how many people remained?
questions.explanation: Twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

questions.text: How many men lapped the water, putting their hand to their mouth?
questions.explanation: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men.

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh tell Gideon to take with him down to the camp if he was afraid?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "If you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp."

questions.text: In the dream Gideon overheard, what tumbled into the camp of Midian?
questions.explanation: The man dreamed that a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian and struck the tent so that it fell.

answers.text: A great stone from the mountain

questions.text: How did the man's fellow explain the dream?
questions.explanation: His fellow answered, "This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel."

answers.text: As a famine coming on Midian
As the sword of Gideon the son of Joash
As a sign that Midian would win
As a warning to flee across the Jordan

questions.text: Into how many companies did Gideon divide the three hundred men?
questions.explanation: He divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave them trumpets and empty pitchers with torches inside.

questions.text: What did the men hold in their left hands during the attack?
questions.explanation: They held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow.

questions.text: What did the three companies shout after breaking the pitchers?
questions.explanation: They shouted, "The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!"

answers.text: "The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!"

questions.text: What were the names of the two princes of Midian who were taken and killed?
questions.explanation: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb, and brought their heads to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
